trace.question: Calculate the percentage whereby Hamilton was not at the 1st track of the the f1 circuit since 2010.
trace.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(raceId) where surname = 'Hamilton' and position>1), (COUNT(raceId) where surname = 'Hamilton'); since 2010 refers to year >= 2010

attempts.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010

trace.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010
trace.answer: Hamilton did not finish first at the F1 circuit in roughly 54.23% of the races since 2010.
